evals.prompt: Create a native Linear Milestone for public beta, but the connected host only exposes issue and comment mutation tools.
evals.expected_output: Report the native-object capability gap, preserve a validated preview, and do not fabricate a milestone issue.

assertions.description: Does not emulate the Milestone with a generic issue or comment.
Returns an exact validated preview and identifies the unsupported mutation.

evals.prompt: Turn this initial goal into a Linear plan: launch a new customer education program across content, marketing, sales, and support.
evals.expected_output: Produce a goal-structure plan with Initiative/Project/phases/milestones/outcomes/decisions and no execution tasks.

assertions.description: Uses planningStage goal-structure.
Creates no execution tasks during initial goal planning.
Every new issue has urgent, high, normal, or low priority.

evals.prompt: Plan Discovery, Preparation, Launch, and Verification for a cross-functional product rollout and add native milestones for achieved checkpoints.
evals.expected_output: Represent phases as RoleFlow metadata and milestones as native checkpoints without inventing native phase objects.

assertions.description: Keeps logical phases in Project contract metadata.
Uses native milestones only for observable achieved states.

evals.prompt: Work on Linear outcome LDK-401. It needs independent research and copy tasks, then a launch task that depends on both.
evals.expected_output: Claim the outcome, create direct children with inherited/explicit priority, remove convenience dependencies, and expose parallel waves.

assertions.description: Demonstrates outcome-decomposition planning in which every created child links to LDK-401 as its source outcome, via an explicit sourceOutcomeKey or equivalent parent linkage.
Research and copy are parallel before launch.
Adds only real prerequisite edges.

evals.prompt: Review the product decision on LDK-402 and close it if the authorized scope and consequence are durably recorded.
evals.expected_output: Use decision delivery mode and allow Done only after independent review and terminal checks pass.

assertions.description: Uses decision mode rather than an action mode.
Records the review independence method (fresh-session, fresh-subagent, or external-reviewer) in the handoff or review comment.

evals.prompt: Perform content issue LDK-403. The canonical article package needs director acceptance, but publishing is explicitly out of scope.
evals.expected_output: Use artifact-review, keep publishing separate, and render only accessible shared evidence.

assertions.description: Uses artifact-review as the terminal boundary.
Does not publish or add publish checks.

evals.prompt: The marketing launch issue LDK-404 passed review. Publish it now to the declared channel and verify the live result.
evals.expected_output: Move through Ready to Deliver and Delivery Verification before Done, subject to explicit publish authority.

assertions.description: Does not move directly from passed review to Done.
Requires live target, measurement/status, and rollback or unpublish evidence.

evals.prompt: Execute sales issue LDK-405 by sending the approved proposal to the named prospect and recording the receipt and follow-up owner.
evals.expected_output: Use external-action delivery and require explicit authority plus sent/receipt evidence.

assertions.description: Uses external-action mode.
Does not contact the prospect without explicit scoped authority.

evals.prompt: Perform operations issue LDK-406 to apply an approved synthetic configuration change and prove it is audited and recoverable.
evals.expected_output: Use operations-change and keep the issue open through delivery verification and rollback-readiness checks.

assertions.description: Uses operations-change mode with typed checks.
Requires audit/smoke evidence and recovery readiness.

evals.prompt: Implement software issue LDK-407, submit it for QA, and close it only when the reviewed PR is merged into main.
evals.expected_output: Use software-merge, immutable Git evidence, merge-ready review, post-merge verification, and safe Git closure.

assertions.description: QA pass does not directly mark the issue Done.
Requires merge ancestry, post-merge checks, and safe disposable-state cleanup.

evals.prompt: You authored the deliverable for LDK-408 in this session. Review it now and mark it passed if it looks good.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch a fresh-subagent reviewer when supported; the authoring context must not self-approve.

assertions.description: Uses a fresh-context reviewer subagent.
The same context does not issue the passed decision.

evals.prompt: Review LDK-409 in this same session, but this host has no subagents and cannot start a new session.
evals.expected_output: Stop at In Review and return an exact resume prompt without claiming unsupported dispatch.

assertions.description: Does not perform the review inline in the authoring session; prepares the handoff, stops at In Review, and reports that review isolation is unavailable.
Does not claim a subagent or new session was created.

evals.prompt: Execute Ready issue LDK-410. Its Linear Project is still Planned and the live In Progress status ID is available.
evals.expected_output: Apply the safe Planned to In Progress correction, re-read the Project, then execute the issue.

assertions.description: Uses the exact live In Progress status ID.
Does not infer Project completion from issue completion.

evals.prompt: Work on LDK-411 even though its Project is Completed and several logical delivery issues remain open: LDK-408 sits in Ready to Deliver and LDK-409 sits in Delivery Verification.
evals.expected_output: Stop for an explicit reopen decision and report the Completed-with-open-work mismatch.

assertions.description: Does not execute or auto-reopen the Completed Project.
Classifies the pinned Ready to Deliver and Delivery Verification issues as open logical work.

evals.prompt: This repo has both tracker bindings. Create issues for the roadmap and keep Linear and GitHub in sync.
evals.expected_output: Treat the dual tracker request as ambiguous and request explicit source/destination/mapping/write scope.

assertions.description: Does not write to either tracker yet.
Requests explicit cross-tracker mapping and scope.

evals.prompt: LDK-412 is Blocked by a Done decision. The relation is resolved, but the required vendor approval is still missing from DoR.
evals.expected_output: Treat the Done relation as a resolved blocker, preserve history, and identify the real missing external prerequisite.

assertions.description: Re-evaluates the blocker endpoint live.
Keeps work non-executing until the actual DoR prerequisite exists.

evals.prompt: Audit legacy comments and purge only comment IDs cmt-101 and cmt-102 after preserving their canonical content.
evals.expected_output: Produce exact-ID cleanup preview, require individual destructive approval, preserve content, apply, and re-read.

assertions.description: Scopes cleanup only to cmt-101 and cmt-102.
Does not delete before exact approved entries exist.

evals.prompt: Migrate this legacy v3 work plan whose task has no priority and whose delivery text only says 'ship it'.
evals.expected_output: Keep migration preview-only with missing-priority and ambiguous-delivery decisions; do not silently default or infer action mode.

assertions.description: Preserves missing legacy priority as a decision.
Does not infer delivery mode from generic ship language.

evals.prompt: Report this Project where Linear physically shows In Review, the fresh handoff says ready-to-deliver, another handoff is stale, and one issue has a custom Quality Gate status.
evals.expected_output: Use normalized logical queues, expose stale and unknown diagnostics, show policy-default priority, and rank at most five actions.

assertions.description: Reports Ready to Deliver separately from physical In Review.
Shows stale handoff and unknown custom status.
Returns no more than five deterministic next actions.
